LESSON: HISTORIC BUILT ENVIRONMENTS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.5: Historic Built Environments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Historic Built Environments. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we conserve the historic built environments?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the importance of the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa
3. demonstrate ways of conserving historic built environments in Eastern Africa
4. value historic built environments in Eastern Africa and in the locality

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HISTORIC BUILT ENVIRONMENTS
This lesson teaches Historic Built Environments for Grade 6 SOCIAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa on a map
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe the importance of the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. demonstrate ways of conserving historic built environments in Eastern Africa
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. value historic built environments in Eastern Africa and in the locality
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Historic Built Environments using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Historic Built Environments above.
2. Explain Historic Built Environments to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Historic Built Environments.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Historic Built Environments with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Historic Built Environments important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we conserve the historic built environments?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the importance of the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa
3. demonstrate ways of conserving historic built environments in Eastern Africa
4. value historic built environments in Eastern Africa and in the locality

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
